articles.translatedExcerpt: Toma Ikuta released his first full-length album ``NASCENCE'' (pronunciation: naisense) ahead of the CD release on November 25th (Wednesday). Lyric videos for all songs from the album are also released, which combine all songs into one video. articles.translatedExcerpt: Crab Crab Club released their new song "Homing" today, November 4, 2026 (Wednesday). This work is a sci-fi rock number that depicts the feelings of two people separated by several light years, with the theme of feelings for "you" that never disappear no matter how far apart they are. This is a song that embodies Crab Club's unique worldview, which combines sci-fi ideas with everyday emotions, layering the loneliness and love that everyone knows on a grand space story. In terms of sound, it's guitar rock centered around lightly moving guitar phrases and the dynamic groove of the bass and drums. The bright sound with a sense of speed is layered with the echo of the heartrending lyrics. The jacket consists of an illustration by illustrator "Pin Ponpo." and the title logo of Crab Kani Club's Dr. Ryuto. A music video produced by the two will also be released at a later date.

The central theme of this work is the expectations imposed by society and those around you, and how to free yourself from these expectations. articles.translatedTitle: shosha releases introspective new song “Anchor”
articles.translatedExcerpt: shosha released a new single "Anchor" on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. This is his fourth work since the beginning of this year, and it is a song that introspectively depicts the process of being in the midst of love and heading towards its end. The song's lyrics are based on the contradictions and conflicts between the desire to hold back the person who is leaving and the resignation that is accepting the ending, and the title ``Anchor'' is a metaphor for trying to hold on to the heart of someone who is leaving. The sound is a pop-oriented liquid drum and bass. Layering whispering vocal samples, gentle felt piano chords, and a low, crawling Reese bass, they create a quiet yet propulsive beat. Additionally, the album will be released on November 25th (Wednesday). It is scheduled to include a total of 8 songs, including previously released songs that have been released since September.

articles.translatedExcerpt: It has been decided that NEK! will be performing at the music festival <Ukigensai EMERGE FEST 2027> to be held in Taiwan. EMERGE FEST 2027, which will be held on February 20th and 21st, 2027 at Qingshui Weifengshan Sports Park in Taichung, Taiwan, will bring together up-and-coming rock acts from all over Asia, and is one of Taiwan's best outdoor festivals, with tickets selling out for six consecutive years. This will be NEK!'s first appearance at a major overseas festival. Furthermore, in Japan, they will be holding a nationwide tour called ``NEK! LIVE TOUR 2027'', which will include 12 performances in 11 locations nationwide, starting with the ESAKA MUSE performance in Osaka on January 10, 2027. articles.translatedTitle: The Weeknd releases new song “HONG KONG (feat. Wang Fei Season Wind)” expressing his love for Hong Kong
articles.translatedExcerpt: The Weeknd has released a new song, "HONG KONG (feat. Wang Fei Season Wind)". The song was a surprise release by The Weeknd at 1:00 a.m. on November 1, 2026, to mark the end of the Hong Kong tour of the After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour, which recorded the highest box office revenue for a male artist in history, and expressed his love and respect for Hong Kong. It was first performed at the Kai Tak Stadium performance on October 24th, which was the opening of four performances in Hong Kong, and was created as a tribute to the city and music culture of Hong Kong. The song samples the original sound source and Cantonese vocals from Faye Wong's 1993 hit song "Monsoon." The Weeknd has been into Cantonese pop and Wong Kar-wai's films...

articles.translatedTitle: TiDE releases MV for “Ordinary” shot entirely on film
articles.translatedExcerpt: TiDE has released the music video for the lead song "Nordinary" from the EP "Dialogue" released on October 28, 2026. This music video, directed by Futoshi Nakazawa, was shot entirely on film. It is said that the emotions and sound scale of the song, such as "worries, conflicts, and determination," are expressed in the video. Regarding this music video, Daigo Inoue (Vo, G) commented as follows. ◆ ◆ ◆ ◾️ Comments from Daigo Inoue The song ``Nordinary'' was born by facing my current state of mind as I live a completely different life from the ``normal'' life I envisioned a few years ago. articles.translatedTitle: Jun Togawa and Yapoos release 1985 live video of global viral hit “Suki, Suki, Isai”
articles.translatedExcerpt: The 1985 live video of Jun Togawa and Yapooz's song ``Suki suki sai sai'' has been remastered and restored in HD and released. "Suki Suki Aishi" is an unusual love song released by Jun Togawa in 1985. Coupled with the shocking phrase "If you don't say I love you, I'll kill you," which he wrote himself, has long earned him a strong following, and in recent years, he has become a global viral hit thanks to overseas TikTok, and the number of new listeners across borders is increasing exponentially every day. Just in time for Halloween, the live video was uploaded on YouTube and the Chinese video site bilibili's Alpha Music official channel. The video is an excerpt from a live performance performed by Jun Togawa and Yapoos on November 28, 1985 at the Osaka Welfare Pension Hall, and has already been commercialized as TOUR-LIVE '85-'86.

articles.translatedTitle: Da-iCE releases lyric video for new song “Uraraka” drawn by one-stroke illustrator ponchi
articles.translatedExcerpt: Da-iCE has released the lyric video for ``Uraraka,'' the theme song for Fuji TV's Thursday Theater ``Nami Urarakani, Meoto Biyori.'' articles.translatedExcerpt: ACIDMAN has announced the start of their anniversary year in preparation for their 30th anniversary in 2027. As the first part of the 30th anniversary project, they have announced that they will hold a one-man live show <ACIDMAN ONE-MAN LIVE “deep”>, and the second nationwide tour <ACIDMAN LIVE TOUR “Second line & Acoustic collection III”>, and have also released a special 30th anniversary website. The eye-catching image of the Earth that serves as the main visual for the 30th anniversary special site is created by the Earth observation video platform "TerraCaster," a joint venture between Nippon Television Network Corporation and Bascule Co., Ltd. This is based on actual observation data from the meteorological satellite "Himawari" and is carved by the movement of clouds and sunlight.

articles.translatedExcerpt: INORAN has announced that he will hold his first live concert in 2027, which will mark his 30th anniversary as a solo artist. This announcement was made on stage at their live performance <TOUR Determine 2026 GRAND FINAL “Naked Again” at Zepp DiverCity TOKYO, which took place today. articles.translatedTitle: Ado, anime “Demon’s Crest” opening theme “Shinka” will be distributed
articles.translatedExcerpt: Ado has announced that his new song "Shinka" will be released on November 6, 2026. This song will be used as the opening theme for the anime ``Demon's Crest'', which will be distributed exclusively worldwide on Prime Video from 9pm on the same day as the release date, and is a new song written by Vocaloid P Yuurii Kanon, who has been in contact with Ado for some time. This work depicts the desire to believe in one's own voice and expression in a world covered in lies and fiction, where even life and human will are looked down upon. The emotional melody and lively sound overlap, powerfully expressing determination to grow and hope for the future. The song is said to be an up-tempo song in which delicate emotions and dynamic development intertwine, and while it is close to the ``evolution'' of each listener, it is also in line with the worldview of anime where ``reality'' and ``games'' invade each other.

In addition to the new song "Fever," this album includes six songs from three past albums that were previously only available on imported CDs and have not been released in Japan. Ikeda's sound approach, which plays a variety of instruments such as the saxophone and Moog synth, overlaps with the worldview of "Circus Night," and this collaboration was made possible by Sakura Fujiwara's love call. articles.translatedTitle: petalhead releases new SG “Nanairo Resident”
articles.translatedExcerpt: Petalhead, an indie pop project based in Tokyo, released their new single "Nanairo Jumin" on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. This work is a song that has been converted into a sound source of the songs that they have performed live. The film depicts the delicate feelings of wandering between admiration and love through the perspective of looking at someone who lives an easy life from a place that is impossible for oneself. Set to a melody that was born while riding a bicycle along a river, the song depicts everyday scenes and the feelings hidden deep in one's heart. Scattered with colorful words such as ``Nanairo Resident'' and ``Peach-colored I am,'' as well as fantastical motifs such as ``Early Summer Galaxy'' and ``Stars,'' a poetic worldview with a lightness and sadness is spread throughout. When creating the sound source, I wanted to capture the tranquility and intimacy that can only be achieved by playing and singing...

articles.translatedTitle: ayU tokiO releases new song “amber” using vintage sampler MPC2000
articles.translatedExcerpt: ayU tokiO released a new song "amber" today, October 28, 2026 (Wednesday). This work, which is about a year after his previous work "Star Call", was created using the vintage sampler "AKAI MPC2000". This work moves away from the post-production process that has been emphasized in music production up until now, and focuses on pre-production, which is the process of planning and arranging a song. ``Create a sequence,'' ``Run midi,'' and ``Make a performance.'' For ayU tokiO, who has aimed to raise the resolution of the songs by revisiting them through vintage machines and sublimate the demo sound sources created during the production process into a single work, this song can be said to be the culmination of their efforts. articles.translatedExcerpt: Houkago Hotaru released their new single "Torus" on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. This work is an emotional song that depicts past pain and self-transformation, centered around a sad melody. Using the motifs of rings and marks left on fingers, he expresses the memories that repeat even after a relationship with someone ends, and the changes in oneself as one looks at the same past. In the second rap part, the conflict between one's own weaknesses and wanting to change comes to light. This is a story of self-acceptance and rebirth, going through a cycle of regret and regret, and finally moving towards a new vow despite the pain. While the sound is based on ballads, it ranges from rap parts to anthems, with arrangements linked to changing emotions. The members of Houkago Hotaru have commented on this single as follows.
